title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.03603v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: World models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide complementary capabilities for predicting future outcomes from static visual observations. World models can generate concrete visual rollouts of possible futures, while MLLMs can reason abstractly over questions, goals, and rules. However, generated rollouts are stochastic and may be visually plausible but task-incorrect, making it necessary to determine when visual simulation is useful, whether a rollout is credible, and how it should influence the final answer. We formulate this problem as controlled concrete reasoning, where a model learns to invoke, verify, and integrate visual future simulation alongside abstract reasoning. To study this setting, we construct two human-verified benchmarks, VRQABench for controllable spatial lookahead and OpenWorldQA for open-domain physical prediction, and propose Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD). Duri

translated_title: 世界模型遇见语言模型：论具体推理与抽象推理的互补性
translated_abstract: 世界模型和多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）为从静态视觉观测预测未来结果提供了互补的能力。世界模型可以生成可能未来的具体视觉推演，而多模态大语言模型能够对问题、目标和规则进行抽象推理。然而，生成的视觉推演是随机性的，可能在视觉上看起来合理但在任务层面却不正确，因此有必要确定视觉模拟何时有用、某次推演是否可信，以及它应如何影响最终答案。我们将这一问题表述为“受控具体推理”，即模型学习在抽象推理的同时调用、验证和整合视觉未来模拟。为研究这一设置，我们构建了两个经人工验证的基准：用于可控空间前瞻的VRQABench和用于开放域物理预测的OpenWorldQA，并提出了特权未来在策略自蒸馏方法（PF-OPSD）。
tldr: 该论文提出了“受控具体推理”框架，通过构建VRQABench和OpenWorldQA两个人工验证基准以及PF-OPSD自蒸馏训练方法，使模型学会在抽象推理过程中何时调用、验证并整合世界模型的视觉未来模拟能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "controlled concrete reasoning" framework with two human-verified benchmarks (VRQABench and OpenWorldQA) and a Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD) method, enabling models to learn when to invoke, verify, and integrate world models' visual future simulation alongside abstract reasoning.
